item.title: Historic Victory: Vijay to be Sworn in as Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Today
item.description: Actor-turned-politician C. Joseph Vijay will be sworn in as the 13th Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu today at Nehru Stadium, Chennai.

item.title: TVK's New Era: Vijay's First Executive Order Expected on Farmers Welfare
item.description: The incoming TVK government has signaled a major focus on agriculture and rural development in its first 100 days.

item.title: Massive Preparations at Nehru Stadium for Vijay's Oath Ceremony
item.description: Thousands of supporters from across Tamil Nadu are converging on Chennai for the historic swearing-in ceremony.
